name: 19508 · Birdsboro, PA
findings: ZIP 19508 (Birdsboro) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19508 (Birdsboro) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19508 (Birdsboro) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
